mainEntity.name: When will I feel the effect?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many patients notice a sense of refreshed energy within hours of the session, with circulation-related effects developing over the next 24–48 hours. The protocol is designed to support wellness rather than replace medical treatment for specific clinical conditions.

mainEntity.name: Is this a treatment for erectile dysfunction?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This protocol supports general sexual wellness through nutrient and circulation support. Specific medical conditions like erectile dysfunction or low testosterone require dedicated medical evaluation and treatment that we do not provide here. We will refer when appropriate.

Yes. All sessions are conducted in a private clinical setting and the medical consultation is fully confidential, like any other medical service. You will speak only with the clinical staff and the visit is handled with the same standards as any aesthetic medical appointment.
